purpose: Autonomous HB (.hbosc) finds a ring oscillator's frequency

oracle.derivation: Row 1 is the fundamental. ngspice-45 transient of the same ring from .ic v(c1)=0.1 (uic), 400 us at a 1 ns step: mean spacing of rising v(c1)=0 crossings 50..100 is 3.52176 us; a 0.25 ns step gives the same digits.
